title: Las Vegas & Southern Utah Road Trip

days.title: Day 1 — Fly In & Zion
days.subtitle: Sat Jun 6 • Southwest #3983 • TUL→LAS • Kanarra Falls • Zion NP
days.tip: Pick up your rental car at Las Vegas airport right after landing. Drive straight to Kanarraville (2.5 hrs) to hit Kanarra Falls before the crowds build up.

stops.name: Depart Tulsa (TUL) — SW #3983
stops.notes: Southwest Airlines #3983 • Tulsa International Airport • confirmation BYXD5X

stops.name: Arrive Las Vegas (LAS) — Pick Up Car
stops.notes: Harry Reid International Airport • 2h 45m flight • pick up rental car and head north on I-15

stops.name: Kanarra Falls Hike
stops.notes: $15 permit fee • 4 miles round trip • slot canyon with log ladders • water shoes required

stops.name: Fire + Smoke BBQ
stops.notes: Smoked brisket & ribs • Kanarraville, UT • Wed–Sat only

stops.name: Zion NP — Riverside Walk
stops.notes: Easy paved trail • 2 miles RT • follows the Virgin River into the Narrows

stops.name: Oscar's Cafe
stops.notes: Springdale classic • New Mexican cuisine • green chile eggs and burritos

stops.name: Best Western Plus Zion West Hotel
stops.notes: Hurricane, UT • pool • free breakfast • 30 min from Zion

days.title: Day 2 — Zion & Bryce Canyon
days.subtitle: Sun Jun 7 • The Narrows river hike • drive to Bryce • sunset at the rim
days.tip: Bryce Canyon has some of the darkest skies in North America. Step outside after dinner — you can see the Milky Way with the naked eye.

stops.name: The Narrows River Hike
stops.notes: Hike up the Virgin River through slot canyon walls • water shoes and trekking poles essential

stops.name: Angels Landing (alternate)
stops.notes: Permit required via lottery • chains on the final 500-foot spine • not for those with a fear of heights

stops.name: Spotted Dog Restaurant
stops.notes: Springdale • local ingredients • great patio views of Zion cliffs

stops.name: Bryce Canyon NP — Sunset Point
stops.notes: Hoodoo formations glow orange at dusk • best light after 4 PM • elevation 8,012 ft

stops.name: Ruby's Inn Cowboy Buffet
stops.notes: Western-style all-you-can-eat • carving station, prime rib • right at the park entrance

stops.name: Best Western Plus Ruby's Inn
stops.notes: Bryce Canyon City • steps from the park entrance • general store on site

days.title: Day 3 — Bryce Canyon & Capitol Reef
days.subtitle: Mon Jun 8 • Hoodoo trails at dawn • highway 12 drive • Capitol Reef arches
days.tip: Grab an America the Beautiful pass ($80) before the trip. It covers all three national parks — Zion, Bryce, and Capitol Reef.

stops.name: Navajo Loop / Queens Garden Hike
stops.notes: 3 miles • descent into the amphitheater • hoodoos at eye level • best hike in the park

stops.name: Bryce Canyon Pines Restaurant
stops.notes: Homemade pies • fluffy pancakes • great stop before the long drive east on UT-12

stops.name: Capitol Reef National Park
stops.notes: Scenic Drive • Waterpocket Fold • least-crowded of Utah's Mighty 5

stops.name: Hickman Bridge Trail
stops.notes: 2 miles RT • natural bridge 133 ft wide • easy to moderate

stops.name: Cassidy Arch Trail
stops.notes: 3.4 miles RT • named after Butch Cassidy • panoramic views over Grand Wash

stops.name: Rim Rock Patio Restaurant
stops.notes: Torrey, UT • patio dining with canyon views • Utah lamb, local trout

stops.name: Overnight — Torrey, UT
stops.notes: Stay in Torrey near Capitol Reef — Skyridge Inn or Capitol Reef Resort • quiet town, stunning red rock views

days.title: Day 4 — Drive to Lehi & Wedding
days.subtitle: Tue Jun 9 • Capitol Reef → Provo Canyon → Wedding in Lehi
days.tip: Provo Canyon is stunning on the drive north — pull over at Bridal Veil Falls for a quick stretch. Leave Torrey by 9 AM to arrive Lehi comfortably before 6 PM.

stops.name: Depart Torrey / Capitol Reef
stops.notes: Head north on UT-24 then US-89 toward I-15 — about 3 hrs to Lehi

stops.name: Bridal Veil Falls — Provo Canyon
stops.notes: Quick 20-min stop • stunning 607-ft waterfall • short easy walk from the parking area

stops.name: Lunch — Communal Restaurant
stops.notes: Provo • farm-to-table • great stop to freshen up before the wedding

stops.name: Wedding — Lehi, UT
stops.notes: Lehi, Utah • congratulations to the happy couple!

stops.name: Overnight — Lehi / American Fork
stops.notes: Stay near Lehi — need to drive to Las Vegas tomorrow for 7:15 PM flight

days.title: Day 5 — Drive to LAS & Fly Home
days.subtitle: Wed Jun 10 • Lehi → Valley of Fire → Las Vegas • SW #4190 7:15 PM
days.tip: Leave Lehi by 10 AM. Valley of Fire is perfectly on the way — stunning 45-min detour. Be at Harry Reid Airport by 5:30 PM for your 7:15 PM departure.

stops.name: Depart Lehi — Drive to Las Vegas
stops.notes: South on I-15 • about 4 hours to Las Vegas • perfect road trip finale

stops.name: Valley of Fire State Park
stops.notes: Nevada's oldest state park • blazing red Aztec sandstone • Elephant Rock & Fire Wave • $15 entry • 50 min from Las Vegas

stops.name: In-N-Out Burger (Las Vegas)
stops.notes: Classic road trip finale • double-double animal style

stops.name: Return Rental Car & Airport
stops.notes: Harry Reid International • return rental car • allow 1.5 hrs for security

stops.name: Fly Home — SW #4190 LAS→TUL
stops.notes: Southwest #4190 • arrives Tulsa 11:55 PM • 2h 40m flight • confirmation BYXD5X
